name: eve-memory-agent-builder
description: Create, extend, and audit Eve agents with durable memory and source-grounded Wikis.

interface.shortDescription: Build Eve agents with memory and Wikis.
interface.longDescription: Create a complete Eve, PostgreSQL memory, and read-only LLM Wiki agent in one beginner-friendly prompt, or add and audit those layers separately.
defaultPrompt: Create a complete Eve memory and Wiki agent for me.
Create an eve agent with durable memory.
Add durable memory to this eve project.
